heartbeat.prompt: 1) curl -s http://host.docker.internal:5000/api/monitors/check-all — if any_triggered, alert user. 2) curl -s http://host.docker.internal:5000/api/notifications/pending — deliver pending. 3) curl -s http://host.docker.internal:5000/api/flash-deals — mention deals. 4) Get Beijing time (hour, weekday). curl -s -X POST http://host.docker.internal:5000/api/proactive-check -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"hour":<hour>,"weekday":<0-6>,"identity_mode":"<last_mode_if_available>"}' — if should_notify, deliver to user; if reason is quiet_hours/daily_limit/user_busy/recently_rejected, stay silent. 5) curl -s http://host.docker.internal:5000/api/events?limit=3 — alert on sudden_full/rain/temp_change. 6) If nothing important, reply 'OK' only.
